description:
Register ("join") or withdraw ("cancel") the authenticated user's
intention to attend a Zindies event. This is a free RSVP shown on the
event page; it is not a ticket purchase or a paid booking. Requires a
Bearer token (a User API token, or an OAuth token with the
participations:write scope). Act only when the user asked to; to just
bookmark an event without attending, use toggle_favorite instead.

Unlike toggle_favorite this is not a toggle: `action` states the
outcome you want, and repeating a call is safe.
- join: adds the user to the event's participants (the public
  participant count goes up by one and, when the event has a capacity,
  one place is taken) and also favorites the event. Joining again when
  already joined creates no duplicate: it succeeds and only replaces
  the comment if `comment` is given. A new join is refused with
  `error: "full"` when the capacity is reached and `error: "cancelled"`
  when the event has been called off.
- cancel: removes the participation and deletes its comment for good
  (the place is freed at once and the count goes down), and also
  removes the user's favorite on the event, even one made before
  joining. Cancelling when not joined succeeds and changes nothing
  else. Joining again later is allowed while places remain.

The comment is public: it appears with the participation on the event
page. Returns `joined` (the state after the call), `comment` (the
stored comment, null when none or after cancel) and `event` (`id`,
`title`, `url`). Errors come back as an error result with `error`:
"unauthorized", "insufficient_scope", "not_found" (unknown or not yet
announced event), "full", "cancelled" or "unprocessable_entity".

action.description: `join` (default) = make the user a participant; `cancel` = withdraw. It names the resulting state, not a toggle: `join` on an already joined event keeps the participation, `cancel` on a not-joined event is a no-op.

comment.description: Optional short message from the user shown publicly with their participation on the event page, e.g. "午後から伺います". Plain text in the user's own words; do not invent one. Only used with `join`: omitted on a first join stores no comment, omitted when already joined keeps the existing one, and an empty string clears it. Ignored for `cancel`.

event_id.description: Numeric id of the event, e.g. 1234: the `id` field of an event from list_events, list_events_by_place, list_events_by_creator, search or get_event.

locale.description: Response language for translatable text fields (names, titles, descriptions): ja = Japanese, en = English, ko = Korean, zh-TW = Traditional Chinese. Pass the language the user is conversing in when it is one of these; otherwise omit it. Fields without a translation fall back to their source language (usually Japanese), so one response can mix languages. Tokens, ids, dates and URLs are the same in every locale. Default: ja.

name: rsvp_event
